name: Teachable
description_en:
Teachable is a hosted platform for selling courses, coaching, digital downloads and memberships. It combines product creation and learner access with a website, checkout and business tools.

Its commercial focus differs from a school student-information system. Platform subscription, platform transaction fees and payment-processing costs must be evaluated as separate parts of a course business.
description_zh:
Teachable 是销售课程、教练服务、数字下载和会员产品的托管平台，结合产品创作、学员访问、网站、结账及业务工具。

其商业定位不同于学校学籍系统。课程业务需分别评估平台订阅、平台交易费和支付处理成本。

core_features.explanation_en: Sell courses, coaching, downloads and memberships.
core_features.explanation_zh: 销售课程、教练服务、下载和会员产品。

core_features.explanation_zh: 课程交付包含视频、测验、分期内容和移动访问。

core_features.explanation_en: Starter lists a platform fee, while higher advertised plans list zero platform transaction fees.
core_features.explanation_zh: Starter 列平台费，较高公开套餐列平台交易费为零。

official_check.scope: Public official documentation research; no account, purchase, live workflow, performance, owner identity or publication approval verified.

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.en: The homepage describes courses with videos, quizzes and drip content; coaching sessions; downloadable resources; and memberships. Student mobile access and payments are part of the wider offering, while availability and product limits depend on plan. Choosing a membership rather than a one-off course changes the access and billing questions to test.
sections.zh: 首页介绍带视频、测验和分期开放内容的课程、教练服务、下载资源及会员产品。移动学员访问和支付属于更广产品能力，但可用性和产品数受套餐限制。选择会员而非单次课程后，需要测试的访问及计费问题也会改变。

sections.title_en: Example: sell a course with a downloadable workbook
sections.title_zh: 示例：销售含练习册的课程
sections.en: Create a short course and a workbook, then configure the desired offer and learner access. Test an order, a failed payment and a refund/cancellation path; verify access rather than checking only that a receipt exists. Review generated quizzes and subtitles before publishing. This is an illustrative launch checklist, not a Teachable purchase or instructional-quality test.
sections.zh: 创建短课程和练习册，配置销售组合及学员访问。检查下单、支付失败和退款取消路径，应核对访问权，不能只看收据是否存在。发布前需审核生成的测验和字幕。本例是上线检查建议，本文未购买或测试教学质量。

sections.title_en: Subscription price is not total selling cost
sections.title_zh: 订阅价不等于销售总成本
sections.en: The monthly cards list Starter $39 for five products with a 7.5% platform transaction fee, Builder $89 for ten products with 0%, and Growth $189 for 50 products with 0%. Each advertises a seven-day trial. Zero platform transaction fee should not be read as zero payment-processing, tax or optional service cost. Growth also lists certificates and branding removal, so those should not be assigned to every plan. Verify annual-billing offers and regional payment eligibility before quoting a total.
sections.zh: 月付卡列 Starter 每月 39 美元、五个产品、平台交易费 7.5%；Builder 89 美元、十个产品、平台费 0%；Growth 189 美元、50 个产品、平台费 0%。各卡宣传七天试用。平台交易费为零，不代表支付处理、税费或可选服务成本为零。Growth 另列证书及移除品牌，不能归给所有套餐。总价需核对年付促销和地区支付资格。

sections.title_en: A trial is a launch experiment, not a free business forever
sections.title_zh: 试用用于验证上线，不代表永久免费运营
sections.en: The pricing FAQ explicitly says Teachable is paid and offers a seven-day trial rather than a continuing free plan. Begin by identifying a payment-eligible seller account, supported product type and a sample learner. Confirm the terms for refunds, payouts and subscriptions, and export needs before taking real orders. Teachable may fit expertise-based commerce; it does not create audience demand or confer course accreditation. Self-hosting, source licensing, exact regional tax handling and recovery behavior were not verified.
sections.zh: 套餐 FAQ 明确 Teachable 为付费服务，七天试用并非持续免费套餐。先确认具备支付资格的销售账户、受支持产品类型及样例学员，收取真实订单前明确退款、打款、订阅和导出要求。它可能适合知识产品电商，但不会创造市场需求或授予课程认证。自托管、源码许可、具体地区税务处理及恢复行为未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research, original English synthesis and Chinese translation; examples are hypothetical and unexecuted.

research_gaps.en: Verify processor and payout fees, regional seller eligibility, annual promotions, refunds, tax scope and learner-access cancellation.
research_gaps.zh: 需确认处理及打款费用、地区销售资格、年付促销、退款、税务范围和取消访问行为。

research_gaps.en: No live account, purchase, recovery or performance test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际创建账户、购买、测试恢复或测量性能。
